title: The specified compact-support quotient tower has a normalized coherent realization
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $\varpi_E$. Put $A_n=R/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c_0=(j_0,p_0)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $F_n=Rf^{c_0}_{!,n}=Rp_{0*,n}j_{0!}$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

For $T=X,Y$ put $B_{T,n}=(A_n)_T$ and $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n B_{T,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$ for restriction along $B_{T,m}\to B_{T,n}$ and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ for restriction along $\widehat R_T\to B_{T,n}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_X}B_{X,n}$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Assume there are integers $a\leq b$ such that every $K_n$ has Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

For a K-flat representative $P$ of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], let $\rho_{m,n}:K_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$ be induced by the quotient map $P\otimes B_{X,m}\to P\otimes B_{X,n}$. Its adjoint $\beta_{m,n}:K_m\otimes^L_{B_{X,m}}B_{X,n}\to K_n$ is the canonical iterated-reduction isomorphism. These maps are independent of the representative, have identity units, and satisfy the quotient cocycle for $r\geq m\geq n$.

Put $M_n=F_nK_n$ and let
$$\tau_{m,n}:M_m\xrightarrow{F_m(\rho_{m,n})}F_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}F_nK_n$$
use the specified compact-support restriction-of-scalars comparison in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Then $(M_n,\tau_{m,n})$ is a normalized DVR tower in the full sense of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. More explicitly, $\tau_{n,n}=1$ and $\tau_{r,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{r,m}(\tau_{m,n})\circ\tau_{r,m}$, and the tensor/restriction adjoint of $\tau_{m,n}$ is precisely
$$M_m\otimes^L_{B_{Y,m}}B_{Y,n}\longrightarrow F_n(K_m\otimes^L_{B_{X,m}}B_{X,n})\xrightarrow{F_n(\beta_{m,n})}M_n,$$
where the first arrow is the canonical compact-support tensor comparison; both arrows are isomorphisms. There exist cochain complexes $C_n$ of $B_{Y,n}$-module sheaves, identifications $[C_n]\cong M_n$ in their derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and chain maps $C_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}C_n$ representing $\tau_{n+1,n}$. Their composites represent every $\tau_{m,n}$. After restriction to $\widehat R_Y$ these form a strict inverse sequence of complexes, hence a coherent realization $\mathcal M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_{\widehat R_Y}(Y))$ with precisely the evaluations and transitions required by [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Its adjacent transitions are those specifying the integral compact-support limit in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support].

proof.text: Identify the sequence quotient with the direct sheaf quotient using [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. For coefCompactSupportInput_properties, use the native reduction system from [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] and its evaluation maps. Its transition comparison in [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor] conjugates the actual input tau to the native transition. Cancel the evaluation isomorphisms and use the identity and composition equations of [lem-coef-sequence-roos-model] to prove the first two conjuncts. The strictly smaller completed-tower comparison [lem-coef-compact-support-input-tower-compatibility] supplies the third conjunct. The main realization retains its existing direct transition proof.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient maps making the compact-support objects a normalized tower: input quotient maps and output unit/cocycle; returned normalized-realization proof Steps 1--2.

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-cocycle] to the given $k,E,c_0,K$. It gives representative-independent $\rho_{m,n}$, their canonical isomorphism-adjoints $\beta_{m,n}$, and the unit and cocycle of exactly $\tau_{m,n}=\sigma_{m,n,K_n}F_m(\rho_{m,n})$. Its hypotheses hold since $\ell\ne p$ and $f$ is separated finite type; it requires no finiteness of $K$.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient maps making the compact-support objects a normalized tower: input quotient maps and output unit/cocycle; returned normalized-realization proof Steps 1--2.

proof.text: By [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], $K_m$ and $K_n$ are intrinsically bounded constructible. Apply [lem-coef-compact-support-reduction-adjoint] with $V=K_m$, $W=K_n$ and the isomorphism $\beta_{m,n}$ of Step 1. The equality $\rho=\operatorname{Res}(\beta)\eta$ from Step 1 identifies its input map with our quotient map. Its conclusion identifies the actual adjoint of $\tau_{m,n}$ with $F_n(\beta_{m,n})\gamma_{K_m}$ and makes both factors invertible. This uses ordinary finite-level reduction, without flatness of the quotient; the assumed common Tor interval imposes no additional requirement here.

source.place: Paragraph 2, the specified coefficient maps: identification of their tensor/restriction adjoints and finite-comparison invertibility; returned normalized-realization proof Steps 3--4.

proof.text: Use [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] to reduce K in the derived category of the ringed coefficient sequence site. Apply the actual varying-ring open extension and proper direct image. The evaluation and transition comparisons of [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor] and [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition] identify the resulting system N with the specified M_n and tau. The normalization argument in [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], using the finite comparison of Step 2, shows N is normalized. The exact restriction and coherence results of [lem-coef-sequence-roos-model] supply all the equations for [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Choose one complex P representing N, then evaluate P at each finite coefficient level. The localization factorization for exact evaluation identifies these complexes with M_n and identifies every chain map with tau. Restrict P to the completed coefficient sheaf to obtain the actual complex of strict towers. Its evaluation comparisons are the localized ordinary restriction comparisons; their transition equation holds in every cochain degree.

proof.text: The adjacent transition in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] is $F_{n+1}(\rho_{n+1,n})$ followed by $\sigma_{n+1,n}$ and restriction composition. This is the very map of Step 1, and Step 3 realizes that map. Hence the constructed coherent realization has exactly the transitions specifying the integral compact-support limit.
